newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: VENEZUELA'S CANTV RATE INCREASE SEEN AFTER SEPT.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA'S CANTV RATE INCREASE SEEN AFTER SEPT.

text.p: The Venezuelan national telephone company, CANTV, will not receive a third-quarter rate rise until after September because the company's cost structure was still being evaluated, a top government official said on Wednesday.
"There will be no rate rise until after September. The reason is that the costs structure study has not been concluded," Transport and Communications Minister Moises Orozco Graterol told Reuters.
CANTV has proposed a 1.98 percent rate rise for the third quarter.

Orozco has frequently criticized the company, which is run by GTE Corp of the United States, for failing to provide a breakdown of its cost structure to back up its requests for rate increases, which must be approved by the ministry.
CANTV's last increase was 4.18 percent in April.
